caseStudy.title: Food Ordering Platform
caseStudy.headline: A responsive concept, developed into a complete ordering and delivery system.
caseStudy.summary: A multi-restaurant Django application connecting customers, restaurant teams, delivery staff, and administrators through a shared order workflow.
caseStudy.overview: The project began as a responsive food landing-page concept and grew into a full-stack application. The system supports restaurant discovery, meal management, cart and checkout, order tracking, delivery operations, and platform administration.
caseStudy.challenge: Each role needs a clear view of the same order while only controlling the actions they are responsible for. The workflow must move cleanly from customer checkout to restaurant preparation and final delivery.
caseStudy.approach: Built role-specific experiences around a shared order lifecycle, connected the responsive interface to Django-backed data, and added access checks so restaurant owners can only manage their own restaurant operations.
features: Role-based experiences for customers, restaurant owners, delivery staff, and administrators
Restaurant and meal management with responsive browsing and cart workflows
Order status progression from pending through preparation, pickup, transit, and delivery
Polling-based order refresh and notifications for active delivery workflows
Administrative dashboards with platform, user, order, and restaurant analytics
Permission checks that scope owner access to their own restaurant data
